newsitem.title: USA: Affinity Group Holdings issues $130 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Affinity Group Holdings issues $130 mln in debt.

text.p: The following debt issue from Affinity Group Holdings was priced in the private placement market late on Wednesday, according to a high-yield market source.
The deal, which had price talk of 10.75 percent to 11.00 percent, was increased in size by $10 million.

Affinity Group Holdings is the holding company of Affinity Group Inc, its operating subsidiary. Affinity Group is a direct marketing company that primarily sells products and services to its membership base of recreational vehicle owners.
Citicorp Securities Inc was lead manager on the deal.
